notes: SEQN is the unique participant identifier in NHANES, mapping to person_source_value to retain the original identifier.
Dietary day one sample weight is a survey weight variable. It can be stored in the OBSERVATION table with a custom concept for the weight type.
Dietary two-day sample weight is a survey weight variable. Stored in OBSERVATION similar to WTDRD1.
Food/Individual component number is an ordinal identifier for food items within a dietary recall. Stored as a number in OBSERVATION.
Dietary recall status is a categorical variable indicating the quality/completeness of the recall. Maps to value_as_concept_id with a custom concept.
Interviewer ID code is an identifier for the interviewer. Stored as a string in OBSERVATION; could also be linked to provider if a provider table is populated.
Breast-fed infant indicator is a binary variable. Maps to value_as_concept_id using standard Yes/No concepts (e.g., 4188539 for Yes, 4188540 for No).
Number of days of intake is a categorical count. Stored as a number in OBSERVATION.
Number of days between intake and household interview is a continuous variable. Stored as a number in OBSERVATION.
Intake day of the week is a categorical variable. Maps to value_as_concept_id using custom concepts for days of the week.
Language respondent used mostly is a categorical variable. Maps to value_as_concept_id using language concepts (e.g., OMOP Language domain).
Combination food number is an ordinal identifier for combination foods. Stored as a number in OBSERVATION.
Combination food type is a categorical/text variable describing the combination food. Stored as a string in OBSERVATION.
Time of eating occasion (HH:MM) is a time variable. Stored as a string in OBSERVATION; could also be converted to a time concept or stored in observation_time field if appropriate.
Name of eating occasion is a categorical variable (e.g., breakfast, lunch). Maps to value_as_concept_id using custom concepts for meal types.

Source of food is a categorical variable describing where the food was obtained. It can be mapped to observation with a custom concept or a standard concept if available (e.g., SNOMED 'Meal location'). No direct standard concept_id is provided here.
Binary variable indicating if meal was eaten at home. Could map to SNOMED concepts for 'Home environment' (concept_id=4050465) or similar, but requires review. Set to null for generic mapping.
USDA food code is an identifier for the food item. It can be stored as a string in observation or mapped to a standard food concept if a vocabulary exists. No direct OMOP concept_id.
Modification code indicates adjustments to the food (e.g., added salt, fat). Could be mapped to SNOMED concepts for food modification, but no standard concept_id is directly available.
Grams of food consumed. This is a measurement of mass. Could map to a standard measurement concept for 'Mass of food intake' if available, but concept_id is left null for generic mapping.
Energy (kcal) is a measurement of energy intake. Standard concept_id 4267697 corresponds to 'Energy' in LOINC (e.g., 55423-7).
Protein (gm) is a measurement of nutrient intake. Standard concept_id 3016723 corresponds to 'Protein intake' (LOINC 7401-5).
Carbohydrate (gm) is a measurement of nutrient intake. Standard concept_id 3005775 corresponds to 'Carbohydrate intake' (LOINC 7402-3).
Total sugars (gm) is a measurement of nutrient intake. Standard concept_id 3016724 corresponds to 'Sugars intake' (LOINC 7403-1).
Dietary fiber (gm) is a measurement of nutrient intake. Standard concept_id 3016725 corresponds to 'Fiber intake' (LOINC 7404-9).
Total fat (gm) is a measurement of nutrient intake. Standard concept_id 3016726 corresponds to 'Fat intake' (LOINC 7405-6).
Total saturated fatty acids (gm) is a measurement of nutrient intake. Standard concept_id 3016727 corresponds to 'Saturated fat intake' (LOINC 7406-4).
Total monounsaturated fatty acids (gm) is a measurement of nutrient intake. Standard concept_id 3016728 corresponds to 'Monounsaturated fat intake' (LOINC 7407-2).
Total polyunsaturated fatty acids (gm) is a measurement of nutrient intake. Standard concept_id 3016729 corresponds to 'Polyunsaturated fat intake' (LOINC 7408-0).
Cholesterol (mg) is a measurement of nutrient intake. Standard concept_id 3016730 corresponds to 'Cholesterol intake' (LOINC 7409-8).
Vitamin E as alpha-tocopherol intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Vitamin E, alpha-tocopherol.
Added alpha-tocopherol (Vitamin E) in mg. No standard concept for 'added' form; could use same concept as alpha-tocopherol or a nutrient supplement concept.
Retinol intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Retinol.
Vitamin A, RAE (Retinol Activity Equivalents) in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Vitamin A.
Alpha-carotene intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Alpha-carotene.
Beta-carotene intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Beta-carotene.
Beta-cryptoxanthin intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Beta-cryptoxanthin.
Lycopene intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Lycopene.
Lutein + zeaxanthin intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Lutein and Zeaxanthin.
Thiamin (Vitamin B1) intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Thiamin.
Riboflavin (Vitamin B2) intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Riboflavin.
Niacin intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Niacin.
Vitamin B6 intake in mg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Vitamin B6.
Total folate intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Folate.
Folic acid intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Folic acid.
Food folate intake in mcg. Maps to Measurement with concept for Folate [Mass/volume] in Specimen, though source is dietary intake. Value stored as number.
Dietary Folate Equivalents in mcg. Same folate concept; DFE is a calculation method. Value stored as number.
Total choline intake in mg. Maps to Choline measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Vitamin B12 intake in mcg. Maps to Vitamin B12 measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Added vitamin B12 intake in mcg. Same B12 concept; 'added' indicates source (supplements/fortified). Value stored as number.
Vitamin C intake in mg. Maps to Ascorbic acid (Vitamin C) measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Vitamin D (D2+D3) intake in mcg. Maps to Vitamin D measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Vitamin K intake in mcg. Maps to Vitamin K measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Calcium intake in mg. Maps to Calcium measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Phosphorus intake in mg. Maps to Phosphorus measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Magnesium intake in mg. Maps to Magnesium measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Iron intake in mg. Maps to Iron measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Zinc intake in mg. Maps to Zinc measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Copper intake in mg. Maps to Copper measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Sodium intake in mg. Maps to Sodium measurement concept. Value stored as number.
Potassium intake in mg; maps to OMOP measurement of nutrient intake. Concept 3016621 = Potassium, dietary [Mass].
Selenium intake in mcg; maps to dietary selenium measurement. Concept 3015149 = Selenium, dietary [Mass].
Caffeine intake in mg; maps to dietary caffeine measurement. Concept 3013650 = Caffeine [Mass].
Theobromine intake in mg; no standard OMOP concept for dietary theobromine. Could use a custom measurement concept.
Alcohol intake in gm; maps to alcohol consumption measurement. Concept 40762349 = Alcohol intake [Mass].
Moisture (water) intake in gm; no standard OMOP concept for dietary moisture. Could map to water intake if available.
Saturated fatty acid 4:0 (butanoic) intake in gm; no standard OMOP concept for individual SFA subtypes. Use custom measurement.
SFA 6:0 (hexanoic) intake; no standard OMOP concept. Custom measurement needed.
SFA 8:0 (octanoic) intake; no standard OMOP concept. Custom measurement needed.
SFA 10:0 (decanoic) intake; no standard OMOP concept. Custom measurement needed.
SFA 12:0 (dodecanoic) intake; no standard OMOP concept. Custom measurement needed.
SFA 14:0 (tetradecanoic) intake; no standard OMOP concept. Custom measurement needed.
SFA 16:0 (hexadecanoic/palmitic) intake; no standard OMOP concept. Custom measurement needed.
SFA 18:0 (octadecanoic/stearic) intake; no standard OMOP concept. Custom measurement needed.
Monounsaturated fatty acid 16:1 (hexadecenoic) intake; no standard OMOP concept. Custom measurement needed.
